note: Commonwealth's Unreal export (slice 17, export.py, docs/shipkit-17): what goes where. Every file is in the ship's frame (origin midships on the load waterline, X forward, Y starboard, Z up: the build's, which is Unreal's) unless said otherwise; sockets and frames in centimetres.

groups.Outside: spar deck and up, the hull's outside, rig, sails, boats, anchors: one mesh per part, its light twin as LOD 1
groups.Decks: each deck below as one merged mesh, streamed by the deck the player is on; the gun deck also kept while she is near the camera, with its twins merged as its LOD 1
groups.Guns: the guns and port lids, apart from everything else, so the game moves them: shared meshes each in its own frame (guns.json 'meshes'), each gun's gear and irons in its port's frame, each lid in its hinge's frame

note_skip: the lofted hull (Clay_Hull) is the skin's reference, hidden
note_skip_collections: the guns' other poses are the same shared meshes placed again: their places go in the sockets file (guns.poses), the game moves one set between them. Their gear meshes (GearRunIn, GearRunOut, GearRecoil) are exported with the rest of each gun's gear

Hold.note: slice 14 writes one file for the orlop and the hold (docs/shipkit-14): read once, its lanterns are the orlop's

note_decks: a part goes to a deck by its collection (the model thread's GunDeck, BerthDeck, Orlop, Hold) or a custom property 'deck'. Everything else is Outside. The gun deck has light twins (seen through the waist and ports); the decks under it do not. A deck's linked copies (the berth deck's hammocks, hooks and messes) are one mesh each in its own frame, every copy placed in the sockets file; a deck's pose collections ('poses': by night, by day) are merged apart as SM_Frigate_<Deck>_<Pose>; each deck's build file ('json') gives its turning parts' frames and its lanterns
note_gun_parts: name pieces that put a part in Guns
note_ship_frame_parts: objects among the guns' collections that are one ship-frame mesh, not a gun's part: the port lids' lanyards for the lids shut (Guns_Housed) and open (Guns_RunIn and Guns_RunOut), and the carronades' chocks (one object for every port, guns.json meshes). Exported with the outside parts, in the ship's frame, with their states; placed by the ship, not the battery
note_outside_json: the spar deck's build file: its 'frames' are the turning parts on deck (the wheel, the capstan's drumhead), exported in their own frames and placed like the gun deck's
